key_provisions_or_claims: Singapore has advanced AI strategy but gaps remain in public literacy, workforce readiness, and operational regulatory clarity.
AI threatens psychological, social, economic, military, civil and digital aspects of national resilience if unmanaged.
Recommends adaptive AI governance and competency-based human resource development.
Recommends public AI literacy and penta-helix stakeholder collaboration toward AI-Society 2030.
annotation.summary_en: Library catalogue record for a Lemhannas (Indonesian National Resilience Institute) study on improving Singapore society's AI mastery to strengthen national resilience. It finds gaps in public literacy, workforce readiness, regulatory clarity and stakeholder synergy, and recommends adaptive AI governance, competency building and penta-helix collaboration toward AI-Society 2030.
annotation.title_clean: Meningkatkan penguasaan teknologi AI (Artifical Intelligence) masyarakat Singapura untuk memperkuat ketahanan nasional
annotation.title_en: Improving Singapore Society's Mastery of AI Technology to Strengthen National Resilience
